qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Loss of Costco Kirkland contract, US managed-care/Medicare Advantage intermediary ASP squeeze, and entry-level commoditization from OTC hearing aids and Apple AirPods Pro compress real pricing power and margins.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Pricing Power, REJECT). While Sonova maintains strong DSP audiology engineering, pricing power is structurally compromised by FDA OTC hearing-aid deregulation, Apple AirPods Pro encroaching at 1/10th the cost ($250 vs $3k+), and managed-care/Costco wholesale channel pricing pressure.
qualitative.evidence: Operating margins under multi-year pressure from channel shifting toward discount/managed care and loss of the Costco Kirkland contract. Regulatory OTC deregulation and Big Tech consumer audio integration permanently cap entry-level hearing aid ASPs.
